blurbClaude: Claude Code's hooks call harbard so Claude receives the notes on the bus.
blurbCodex: Codex's hooks register each session on the bus and pass it the summaries.
blurbCursor: Cursor's hooks put the summaries in the agent's context.
errorWireOne: Couldn't connect {tool}: try again or untick it.
errorWireMany: Couldn't connect {count} tools: try again or untick them.
title: Set up harbard
welcomeLead: Connect your coding agents to harbard so they receive your notes, accept the work you hand them and appear in the console.
welcomeNote: An agent only hears your notes through a hook, which gives it a summary at the start of each turn. Without connecting it, your messages seem not to arrive.
chooseHint: Choose which ones harbard connects. You can change it later with harbard install.
chooseNoneHint: Install Claude Code, Codex or Cursor and come back, or skip this step and connect them from the terminal.
wireIncompleteNote: The ones that failed are still not connected: their agents won't receive anything from the bus.
wireNote: harbard adds its hooks to each tool's configuration without touching the ones already there.
doneNote: Open a session in any of them: it will show up in the console and start receiving your notes.
